sentences.text:
2016)  vs In Re: Sany @ Sanyrul Sk on 18 October, 2023 18.10.2023  Sl. No.24  akd  [Rejected]
 C. R. M. (DB) 3883 of 2023

In Re: An application for bail under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal  Procedure filed on 30.10.2023 in connection with Kaliachak Police  Station Case No.756 of 2016 dated 26.10.2016 under Sections  302/376(2)(g)/201/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

And  In Re: Sany @ Sanyrul Sk.
 ... ... Petitioner  Mr. Mazhar Hossain Chowdhury  ... ... for the petitioner  Mr. Neguive Ahmed .. ld.

Addl. Public Prosecutor  Ms. Amita Gaur  ... ... for the State  1.
Heard the learned Advocates appearing for both the parties.
From the report it appears cross- examination of the Investigating Officer has been deferred at the behest of the defence till 16.12.2023.
3. We have considered the materials on record.
There are ample materials implicating the petitioner in the murder.
Though he has suffered incarceration for a considerable period of time, we take note of the fact that offences, if proved, would attract mandatory life imprisonment.
We also take note of the conduct of the defence who had sought adjournment of cross-examination of the Investigating Officer on a number of occasions and delayed the proceeding.
4. Under such circumstances, we are not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner at this stage.
5. The application for bail is thus rejected.

6. Trial court is directed to conduct the trial as expeditiously as possible and conclude the same at an early date preferably within six months from the next date fixed for recording evidence without granting unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties.
